006package dev.metaschema.core.datatype;
007
008import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonGenerator;
009import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonParser;
010
011import org.codehaus.stax2.XMLEventReader2;
012import org.codehaus.stax2.XMLStreamWriter2;
013import org.codehaus.stax2.evt.XMLEventFactory2;
014
015import java.io.IOException;
016import java.net.URI;
017
018import javax.xml.stream.XMLEventWriter;
019import javax.xml.stream.XMLStreamException;
020import javax.xml.stream.events.Characters;
021import javax.xml.stream.events.StartElement;
022import javax.xml.stream.events.XMLEvent;
023
024import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IAnyAtomicItem;
025import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.AbstractAtomicOrUnionType;
026import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.DataTypeItemType;
027import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IAtomicOrUnionType;
028import dev.metaschema.core.model.util.JsonUtil;
029import dev.metaschema.core.model.util.XmlEventUtil;
030import dev.metaschema.core.qname.IEnhancedQName;
031import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
032import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
033
034/**
035 * Provides a basic Java type adapter implementation. This implementation should
036 * be the parent class of all Java type adapter implementations.
037 *
038 * @param <TYPE>
039 *          the raw Java type this adapter supports
040 * @param <ITEM_TYPE>
041 *          the metapath item type supported by the adapter
042 */
043public abstract class AbstractDataTypeAdapter<TYPE, ITEM_TYPE extends IAnyAtomicItem>
044    implements IDataTypeAdapter<TYPE> {
045  /**
046   * The default JSON property name for a Metaschema field value.
047   */
048  public static final String DEFAULT_JSON_FIELD_VALUE_NAME = "STRVALUE";
049
050  @NonNull
051  private final Class<TYPE> valueClass;
052  @NonNull
053  private final IAtomicOrUnionType<ITEM_TYPE> itemType;
054
055  /**
056   * Construct a new Java type adapter for a provided class.
057   *
058   * @param valueClass
059   *          the Java value object type this adapter supports
060   * @param itemClass
061   *          the Java type of the Matepath item this adapter supports
062   * @param castExecutor
063   *          the method to call to cast an item to an item based on this type
064   */
065  protected AbstractDataTypeAdapter(
066      @NonNull Class<TYPE> valueClass,
067      @NonNull Class<ITEM_TYPE> itemClass,
068      @NonNull AbstractAtomicOrUnionType.ICastExecutor<ITEM_TYPE> castExecutor) {
069    this.valueClass = valueClass;
070    this.itemType = new DataTypeItemType<>(this, itemClass, castExecutor);
071  }
072
073  @Override
074  @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
075  public TYPE toValue(Object value) {
076    return (TYPE) value;
077  }
078
079  @Override
080  public Class<TYPE> getJavaClass() {
081    return valueClass;
082  }
083
084  @Override
085  public IAtomicOrUnionType<ITEM_TYPE> getItemType() {
086    return itemType;
087  }
088
089  @Override
090  public boolean canHandleQName(IEnhancedQName nextQName) {
091    return false;
092  }
093
094  @Override
095  public String getDefaultJsonValueKey() {
096    return DEFAULT_JSON_FIELD_VALUE_NAME;
097  }
098
099  @Override
100  public boolean isUnrappedValueAllowedInXml() {
101    return false;
102  }
103
104  @Override
105  public boolean isXmlMixed() {
106    return false;
107  }
108
109  @Override
110  public TYPE parse(XMLEventReader2 eventReader, URI resource) throws IOException {
111    StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
112    XMLEvent nextEvent;
113    try {
114      while (!(nextEvent = eventReader.peek()).isEndElement()) {
115        if (!nextEvent.isCharacters()) {
116          throw new IOException(String.format("Invalid content %s",
117              XmlEventUtil.toString(nextEvent, resource)));
118        }
119        Characters characters = nextEvent.asCharacters();
120        builder.append(characters.getData());
121        // advance past current event
122        eventReader.nextEvent();
123      }
124
125      // trim leading and trailing whitespace
126      String value = ObjectUtils.notNull(builder.toString().trim());
127      try {
128        return parse(value);
129      } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
130        throw new IOException(
131            String.format("Malformed data '%s'%s. %s",
132                value,
133                XmlEventUtil.generateLocationMessage(nextEvent, resource),
134                ex.getLocalizedMessage()),
135            ex);
136      }
137    } catch (XMLStreamException ex) {
138      throw new IOException(ex);
139    }
140  }
141
142  /**
143   * This default implementation will parse the value as a string and delegate to
144   * the string-based parsing method.
145   */
146  @Override
147  public TYPE parse(JsonParser parser, URI resource) throws IOException {
148    String value = parser.getValueAsString();
149    if (value == null) {
150      throw new IOException(
151          String.format("Unable to get null value as text%s",
152              JsonUtil.generateLocationMessage(parser, resource)));
153    }
154    // skip over value
155    parser.nextToken();
156    try {
157      return parse(value);
158    } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
159      throw new IOException(
160          String.format("Malformed data '%s'%s. %s",
161              value,
162              JsonUtil.generateLocationMessage(parser, resource),
163              ex.getLocalizedMessage()),
164          ex);
165    }
166  }
167
168  @SuppressWarnings("null")
169  @Override
170  public String asString(Object value) {
171    return value.toString();
172  }
173
174  @Override
175  public void writeXmlValue(
176      Object value,
177      StartElement parent,
178      XMLEventFactory2 eventFactory,
179      XMLEventWriter eventWriter)
180      throws IOException {
181    try {
182      String content = asString(value);
183      Characters characters = eventFactory.createCharacters(content);
184      eventWriter.add(characters);
185    } catch (IllegalArgumentException | XMLStreamException ex) {
186      throw new IOException(ex);
187    }
188  }
189
190  @Override
191  public void writeXmlValue(Object value, IEnhancedQName parentName, XMLStreamWriter2 writer) throws IOException {
192    String content;
193    try {
194      content = asString(value);
195      writer.writeCharacters(content);
196    } catch (IllegalArgumentException | XMLStreamException ex) {
197      throw new IOException(ex);
198    }
199  }
200
201  @Override
202  public void writeJsonValue(Object value, JsonGenerator generator) throws IOException {
203    try {
204      generator.writeString(asString(value));
205    } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
206      throw new IOException(ex);
207    }
208  }
209
210  @Override
211  public abstract ITEM_TYPE newItem(Object value);
212}
